name: dslop
description: Detect Similar/Duplicate Lines Of Programming - Find code duplication in your codebase

scripts.build:
bun build ./index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && sed -i '' '1,3d' ./dist/index.js && sed -i '' "s/__INJECT_VERSION__/$VERSION/g" ./dist/index.js && echo '#!/usr/bin/env node
' | cat - ./dist/index.js > temp && mv temp ./dist/index.js && chmod +x ./dist/index.js
scripts.release: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push && git push --tags && npm publish
